primary_h3_o2_macro_mae: Within each validation year x cell preserve frozen relative cell_weight_v5_1 among H3 O2-ready rows; renormalize after missing outcomes. Give 2022 and 2023 equal weight inside each cell, then average the six cell MAEs equally.
per_year_gate: Compute six-cell macro MAE separately in 2022 and 2023; candidate must be strictly lower than C0 in both years.
primary_improvement_gate: (C0 H3 macro MAE - candidate H3 macro MAE) / C0 H3 macro MAE must be >= 0.05.
o1_normalized_shape_error: Build six empirical H3 O1 cell targets with equal-year and frozen relative league weights. Normalize empirical targets and each candidate six-cell vector separately by their own six-cell arithmetic mean. Shape error is equal-cell mean absolute deviation; candidate/C0 error minus 1 must be <= 0.02.
h2_robustness: On the intersection with finite H2 O2 and H3 O2, compare candidate H2 macro MAE with candidate H3 macro MAE on the identical rows and weights; relative regression must be <= 0.02.
h4_robustness: On mature validation rows with finite H4 O2 and H3 O2, compare candidate H4 macro MAE with candidate H3 macro MAE on the identical rows and weights; relative regression must be <= 0.02.
non_idp_validation_sensitivity: Diagnostic only; repeat primary H3 O2 validation scoring on non-IDP rows. It cannot alter eligibility or selection.
winner_rule: Among C1/C2/C3 passing every frozen gate, choose lowest H3 O2 validation macro MAE; if within 1% relative MAE, choose fewer effective fitted degrees of freedom in C1/C2/C3 order.
